svg.title: The Harvester — the reaper of the unindexed, ringed by the keepers' sigils.
svg.desc: A hooded shape twice the height of any initiate hangs in the air between the shelf-ranks, more gap than figure: a ragged shroud-cloak trailing to wisps above the bone-strewn floor, and inside the deep cowl not a face but two points of cold, pale light — nothing like the wardens' warm embers. One skeletal hand grips a long-hafted scythe whose blade is a dull metal that reflects nothing. From a low-slung belt-chain swing twelve small iron lanterns, each burning with a little patient flame, and not a name on any of them; the newest hangs with its door ajar. A cold, pale light pools on the floor beneath it. Arcing around the figure in mid-air float eight faint engraved circles, waiting unlit — an anvil under a forge-flame, two chain links, a lens, a coiled echo, a stamped ticket, a branching tree, a rolled map, and a teacup.
